correctness.rationale: Explicit centered proximal derivative reduces global Lipschitz modulus to rank-one operators; the exact quotient variation norm is obtained from dual signs and centered step generators. Eigenvalue identity plus alternating signs and midpoint cut yield the closed formula for all n; near-threshold pairs show sharpness. Nonattainment beyond n=2 is proved. The included checker corroborates rational sign/cut identities and examples.

value.rationale: Natural denoiser combining mean preservation and group sparsity is Euclidean nonexpansive and individually variation diminishing, yet differences can amplify variation by an exactly proved order-n/2 factor.
